title: Paint Fence
statement: Paint `n` fence posts with `k` colors so that at most two adjacent posts share a color. Return the number of ways.
constraints: The answer fits in a 32-bit signed integer for these tests
hints: A post can match the previous one, or differ from it.
same(i) = diff(i - 1), because only one post may match in a row beyond the pair... actually same means this post matches the previous, so the previous pair must have differed.
editorial: Let same be the ways where the last two posts match, and diff the ways where they differ. For one post, there are k ways, all 'different' from a fictional previous post, and same is 0. Then same becomes the old diff, and diff becomes (k - 1) times the old total. The answer after n posts is same + diff.
